description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Draven''' hurls two massive axes in the target direction that briefly grant [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of their surroundings and deal physical damage to enemies hit. Enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] that are damaged to or while below a [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] health threshold equal to the number of ''[[File:Draven League of Draven.png|20xpx|border|link=Draven#League of Draven|An icon for Draven's ability League of Draven]] [[Draven#League of Draven|Adoration]]'' stacks are [[File:Death from Below.png|20px|link=Kill#Execute|An icon representing the keyword Execute]] [[:Kill#Execute|executed]].
description.text: Active: Draven hurls two massive axes in the target direction that briefly grant sight of their surroundings and deal physical damage to enemies hit. Enemy champions that are damaged to or while below a  health threshold equal to the number of Adoration stacks are executed.

description2.raw: ''Whirling Death'' can be recast after 1 second while the axes are traveling, and does so automatically after the axes hit an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] or the edge of the [[Map (League of Legends)|map]].
description2.text: Whirling Death can be recast after 1 second while the axes are traveling, and does so automatically after the axes hit an enemy champion or the edge of the map.

description3.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Draven''' forces the axes to reverse direction, slowly coming to a stop before homing back to him, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
description3.text: Recast: Draven forces the axes to reverse direction, slowly coming to a stop before homing back to him, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.

description4.raw: ''Whirling Death'' deals 100% – 50% (based on enemies hit) damage, resetting upon reversing direction.
description4.text: Whirling Death deals 100% – 50% (based on enemies hit) damage, resetting upon reversing direction.

description5.raw: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''
description5.text: Enemies can be hit only once per pass.

leveling.raw:
'''Physical Damage:'''
200 / 250 / 300 / 350 / 400 (+ 110 / 120 / 130 / 140 / 150% '''bonus''' AD)
'''Total Physical Damage:'''
400 / 500 / 600 / 700 / 800 (+ 220 / 240 / 260 / 280 / 300% '''bonus''' AD)

leveling4.raw:
'''Minimum Physical Damage:'''
100 / 125 / 150 / 175 / 200 (+ 55 / 60 / 65 / 70 / 75% '''bonus''' AD)
'''Minimum Total Damage:'''
200 / 250 / 300 / 350 / 400 (+ 110 / 120 / 130 / 140 / 150% '''bonus''' AD)

notes.raw: * ''Whirling Death's'' projectile has an [[File:Whirling Death Minimap.png|40px|link=]] icon on the mini-map while it is in flight. It can be seen by only '''Draven''' and his allies. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will block one instance of damage. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
notes.text:
